title: Couch Play - One shared screen & your phone is the controller.
author: rectangle_so
selftext:
I've been working on bringing back an old business of mine but this time making it way better than I did before (and its working-ish!!)   
  
Sooo last week I got with my friends and together we played EggVerse & I couldn’t get over the fact that we were all sitting beside each other but looking at our phones... It felt a little awkward.  
  
Then it hit me while walking one day why not have one shared screen (TV/monitor) & use our phones as controllers?

That brings us to today, launching Couch Play!! (name is a WIP) 

If you’ve got a few friends or coworkers give Couch Play a try for your next community / game night. I’d love to hear what works, what’s confusing & which game you want another round of.  
  
No account is needed to play, no ads, and is completely free to play   
  
[**eggverse.co**](https://www.linkedin.com/safety/go/?url=http%3A%2F%2Feggverse%2Eco&urlhash=q-GK&mt=GbPg0h_u7oYl5AAuJsQ47cqSYt5TLoWki_kvp0NGehQVAObZDQSlKX8h9K_tIoIAGFQFeus6lLayHR5WckDD5fccIbpKi2F9PUvcDhXEC7xmd71KLpGG14hqGQ&isSdui=true)

comments.author: rectangle_so
comments.body: Anyone here built something with phones as controllers? I’m trying to make the controls feel natural enough that you’re watching the game & not constantly looking down at your phone lol. Curious what worked for you & what you’d do differently!
